name: snowy-ghost
description: Ovenlight: your own web apps on your phone, from your own computer

plugins.name: ovenlight
plugins.description: Put the web apps you build with Claude Code on your phone, served from your own computer, and share them with family and friends, who only install the Ovenlight app. Claude publishes and checks each app and reads the feedback people send from their phones. It needs a Tailscale account and the Ovenlight connector on your computer.
